## Synopsis

Checks the draft against live state now and prints each line that widens access.
A line that names a text to type is acknowledged by typing that text. The last
question acknowledges every other line. The server checks the draft again as it
publishes, and an object that changed since refuses the publish, so nothing is
written. Only a person publishes, so an admin API token and an agent cannot.

```
strazactl drafts publish <id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --ack stringArray   the text a typed risk asks for, as its line shows it (repeatable)
      --json              print the server's JSON answer, indented, and nothing else on stdout
      --yes               publish without the questions: every risk shown is acknowledged, and each typed risk needs its --ack
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
